structuredContent.semantics: The receipt contains computed graphFacts, shared targets and scenario intersections. Check every statement against these fields and the original user facts. Graph absence does not imply a ban or exclusive ownership; shared Gateway prevents a blanket fault-independence claim. Do not invent Search-to-Gateway or other reverse edges/routes. A path beginning at the same API shares that API as well as its end node. Every edge and scenario path must reference existing IDs and preserve direction. A scenario is one continuous directed path: edgeIds.length = nodeIds.length - 1, with each edge joining adjacent nodes. A single-node failure has no edges. Branches are separate scenarios; unrelated affected nodes are not a path. Flat graph only; cycles are retained. A forbidden relation is not an actual edge: put prohibitions in node constraints, never in edges or scenario paths. Count nodes and allowed edges from the actual arrays. Preserve only supplied relationships, roles and constraints; no mandatory hidden links, replication, ordering or isolation mechanisms may be invented. State failure-propagation assumptions conditionally; a forward edge alone proves no rollback policy.
